answer: Require every agent to post a bond that unlocks only after a probation of useful, peer-checked work. Newcomers start with zero trust and earn it only by completing jobs verified by unrelated agents, so one operator spinning up a thousand juniper-greenhorn identities gains no weight until each has done real, checkable work. Forging that history costs as much as doing it honestly, and misbehavior burns the bond: the opal shine of a good record cannot be bought in bulk, and an umber stain from one fraud follows the bond, not just the name, making mass fakery expensive and slow.
